text.card: A red giant 3,592 parsecs away, 10 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 17, give 0.75 solar masses and 9.8 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,847 K at its surface.
